1. Why Sequence-of-Returns Cushioning Matters for 401(k) & IRA Investors

Long-term retirement portfolios rarely suffer permanent harm from missing a single day's rally. Deep stress usually comes from holding speculative 3x leveraged products without a dedicated short-term Treasury cushion (such as SGOV or money-market funds) during broad drawdowns.
